alcoholic.en: The health poster explains that alcoholic drinks are restricted to adults by law.
alcoholic.zh: 這張健康教育海報說明，含酒精飲料依法限制成年人使用。

cocktail.en: The museum menu shows a historical cocktail name without giving any recipe details.
cocktail.zh: 博物館的菜單展示了一個歷史上的雞尾酒名稱，但沒有提供任何配方細節。

lottery.en: The civics class discussed how the lottery is regulated to protect the public.
lottery.zh: 公民課討論了彩券如何受到規範，以保護大眾。

mistress.en: The old novel uses mistress as a historical social term that needs context.
mistress.zh: 這本老小說把 mistress 當作歷史社會用語，因此需要配合語境理解。

pub.en: The history book describes the pub as a common meeting place in old towns.
pub.zh: 歷史課本描述 pub 是舊時城鎮中常見的聚會場所。

terror.en: The documentary examines how communities recovered after years of terror and conflict.
terror.zh: 這部紀錄片探討社區如何在多年恐懼與衝突後逐步復原。

tobacco.en: The health lesson explains why tobacco products carry serious health warnings.
tobacco.zh: 健康教育課說明了為什麼菸草產品會附有嚴重的健康警語。

torment.en: The novel shows how unfair rumors can torment a person over time.
torment.zh: 這本小說呈現不公平的謠言如何長期折磨一個人。

whip.en: The cooking program uses whip only as a verb for mixing cream quickly.
whip.zh: 這個料理節目只把 whip 當作快速攪打鮮奶油的動詞使用。

whiskey.en: The law treats whiskey as an adult alcoholic product subject to age restrictions.
whiskey.zh: 法律將 whiskey 視為受年齡限制的成人酒精產品。

whisky.en: The label identifies whisky as an alcoholic beverage intended only for adults.
whisky.zh: 標籤指出 whisky 是只供成年人使用的酒精飲料。

wine.en: The health textbook notes that wine is an alcoholic drink for adults only.
wine.zh: 健康課本指出 wine 是僅供成年人飲用的酒精飲料。

ambush.en: The history exhibit mentions an ambush as part of an ancient military campaign.
ambush.zh: 歷史展覽提到一次伏擊，作為古代軍事行動的一部分。

ammunition.en: The museum stores old ammunition as controlled historical artifacts behind secure displays.
ammunition.zh: 博物館把舊彈藥作為受管制的歷史文物，存放在安全展示櫃後。

artillery.en: The museum displays artillery from past wars to explain military history.
artillery.zh: 博物館展示過去戰爭中的砲兵裝備，用來說明軍事歷史。

ax.en: The museum displays an ancient ax as a protected archaeological artifact.
ax.zh: 博物館將一把古代斧頭作為受保護的考古文物展示。

bam.en: The comic uses bam as a sound effect when a door suddenly closes.
bam.zh: 漫畫用 bam 表示門突然關上的聲音效果。

bartender.en: The film shows a bartender working in a restaurant scene for adult customers.
bartender.zh: 電影呈現一名 bartender 在餐廳場景中為成年顧客服務。

bastard.en: The teacher explained that bastard can be offensive and should be used carefully.
bastard.zh: 老師說明 bastard 可能具有冒犯性，因此使用時要特別小心。

chlorine.en: The science class discusses chlorine as a chemical element with important safety rules.
chlorine.zh: 自然課把 chlorine 當作一種化學元素來介紹，並強調重要安全規範。

dosage.en: The health lesson explains that dosage information should come from qualified medical guidance.
dosage.zh: 健康教育課說明，dosage 資訊應以合格的醫療指示為準。

drunkard.en: The old novel uses drunkard as a dated and judgmental description of a character.
drunkard.zh: 這本老小說用 drunkard 作為一個過時且帶有評斷意味的人物描述。

dynamite.en: The museum keeps historical dynamite materials out of reach in a controlled exhibit.
dynamite.zh: 博物館把歷史上的 dynamite 相關物件放在受控展示區，避免接觸。

gin.en: The sign identifies gin as an alcoholic product restricted to adults.
gin.zh: 標示指出 gin 是受限制、僅供成年人使用的酒精產品。

landmine.en: The history lesson explains that a landmine can remain dangerous long after wars end.
landmine.zh: 歷史課說明，landmine 在戰爭結束很久之後仍可能具有危險。

machinegun.en: The museum lists machinegun as an older spelling found in historical records.
machinegun.zh: 博物館指出 machinegun 是歷史紀錄中可見的一種較舊拼法。

massacre.en: The history class studies the massacre through verified records and respectful discussion.
massacre.zh: 歷史課透過經查證的紀錄與尊重的討論來研究這場 massacre。

mortar.en: The museum label identifies mortar as military equipment from a past conflict.
mortar.zh: 博物館標示把 mortar 說明為過去衝突中的軍事裝備。

pesticide.en: The science lesson says pesticide labels include safety warnings that must be followed.
pesticide.zh: 自然課說明 pesticide 標籤會列出必須遵守的安全警語。

ransom.en: The crime report defines ransom as money demanded in an illegal kidnapping case.
ransom.zh: 犯罪報導把 ransom 定義為非法綁架案件中被要求支付的金錢。

retaliate.en: The teacher urged students not to retaliate when conflicts can be solved peacefully.
retaliate.zh: 老師鼓勵學生不要報復，而是用和平方式解決衝突。

saloon.en: The museum rebuilt an old saloon to illustrate life in a frontier town.
saloon.zh: 博物館重建了一間舊式 saloon，用來呈現邊境小鎮的生活。

sever.en: The company decided to sever the outdated connection after a security review.
sever.zh: 公司在安全檢查後決定中止那條過時的連線。

slave n..en: The history textbook explains how an enslaved person was once called a slave.
slave n..zh: 歷史課本說明，過去被奴役的人曾被稱作 slave。

tranquilizer.en: The health textbook describes tranquilizer as a medicine that requires professional medical supervision.
tranquilizer.zh: 健康課本把 tranquilizer 描述為需要專業醫療監督的藥物。

uranium.en: The science museum explains uranium as a radioactive element studied under strict safety rules.
uranium.zh: 科學博物館把 uranium 說明為在嚴格安全規範下研究的放射性元素。
